docs.keeps.component: `Keeper` answers which of a child's capabilities still act while it sits INSIDE this
container. Shape is like `bounds`: no atom at all means everything is allowed, and a list is
a NARROWING. There is no `allow_manual_flip: false` — the canon forbids negation flags —
restriction works by ABSENCE from an allow-list, never by a negative.
import { node, Container, Keeper, keepsAllows } from "game-kit";
keepsAllows(discard, "drag"); // true  — a card may be carried out
keepsAllows(discard, "flip"); // false — not flipped in place
The kit does not gate anything on its own: `keepsAllows` is a question a caller asks before
acting, the same way this page's tap does before it turns the card over.
docs.keeps.zone: One zone, one card. Pick what the zone keeps: no atom (open — the tap always flips it),
`["drag"]` (the card leaves the zone freely but a tap does nothing), or an empty list (the
closed case — nothing beyond what a bare `Draggable` already does). Dragging the card out is
never gated on this shelf: that is `Grabber`'s law, a separate question from `Keeper`'s.
